name: Arcane Fury (Eldritch Knight)
body:
Magic and rage can create a tremendous force when used together.

Requirements

To qualify to become an arcane fury, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Special: rage class feature*.
Spellcasting Able to cast 3rd-level arcane spells.

This alters requirements.

* A skald’s raging song and other forms of rage granted by a class feature count as rage for the purpose of this prestige class.

Furious Arcana

An arcane fury adds his level to any levels he might have in the class that grants him rage for the purpose of his rage class feature. He also adds his level to any levels in an arcane spellcasting class for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites for feats.

This replaces diverse training.

Eldritch Rage

At 1st level, an arcane fury gains the moment of clarity rage power. She may use this power more than once per rage, but must spend 1 additional round of rage for each use beyond the 1st. If the arcane fury already possesses moment of clarity, he can instead select another rage power that has moment of clarity as a prerequisite. At 5th and 9th level, the arcane fury gains another rage power. The character must still meet the prerequisites for these rage powers.

This replaces bonus feats.
